caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, rounded-lid box with a light beige or cream-colored background, decorated with intricate patterns and figures. The main scene on the front of the box features three human figures: a woman in a green dress and hat being lifted or held by two men dressed in pinkish-brown attire with knee-length pants and jackets. The two men stand on either side of the woman, each holding one of her arms. They are positioned in front of green shrubbery and foliage. Additional ornamental elements include pink floral motifs and green scrollwork on the sides and corners of the box. There is a decorative border along the edge of the lid, patterned with small pink flowers and green dots. The overall composition uses a palette of muted pinks, greens, and browns.
title: Bandbox
